test_is_safe_url_public: test the is_safe_url function with a public HTTPS URL and assert it returns True
test_is_safe_url_private_ip: test the is_safe_url function resolves to private IPs like 10.0.0.1, 172.16.0.1, 192.168.1.1 and returns False
test_is_safe_url_cloud_metadata: test the is_safe_url function blocks cloud metadata endpoints like 169.254.169.254 and metadata.google.internal
test_is_safe_url_cgnat: test the is_safe_url function blocks CGNAT range 100.64.0.0/10 addresses not caught by ipaddress.is_private
test_is_blocked_ip_parametrized: test the _is_blocked_ip helper with a parametrized list of blocked IPv4, IPv6, and IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses
